CustomField.description: IM-42: Calculated based on status is approved, then Approved Amount/Term else Proposed Amount/Terms IM-271: Updated the field to account for negative numbers when amended.
CustomField.formula: '$' + IF(RecordType.Name == 'Budgeted Initiative', IF(Approved__c = TRUE, IF( Approved_Amount__c >= 1000000000, TEXT(ROUND(Approved_Amount__c/1000000000,2)) + 'B', IF(Approved_Amount__c >= 1000000, TEXT(ROUND(Approved_Amount__c/1000000,2)) + 'M', IF(Approved_Amount__c >= 1000, TEXT(ROUND(Approved_Amount__c/1000,0)) + 'k', TEXT(Approved_Amount__c)))), IF( Proposed_Amount__c >= 1000000000, TEXT(ROUND(Proposed_Amount__c/1000000000,2)) + 'B', IF(Proposed_Amount__c >= 1000000, TEXT(ROUND(Proposed_Amount__c/1000000,2)) + 'M', IF(Proposed_Amount__c >= 1000, TEXT(ROUND(Proposed_Amount__c/1000,0)) + 'k', TEXT(Proposed_Amount__c)))))+ ' / ' + TEXT(Term_Years__c) + 'yrs', IF(RecordType.Name == 'Amendment', IF( Change_Total_Amount__c >= 1000000000, TEXT(ROUND(Change_Total_Amount__c/1000000000,2)) + 'B', IF(Change_Total_Amount__c >= 1000000, TEXT(ROUND(Change_Total_Amount__c/1000000,2)) + 'M', IF(Change_Total_Amount__c >= 1000, TEXT(ROUND(Change_Total_Amount__c/1000,0)) + 'k', IF(Change_Total_Amount__c <= -1000000000, TEXT(ROUND(Change_Total_Amount__c/1000000000,2)) + 'B', IF(Change_Total_Amount__c <= -1000000, TEXT(ROUND(Change_Total_Amount__c/1000000,2)) + 'M', IF(Change_Total_Amount__c <= -1000, TEXT(ROUND(Change_Total_Amount__c/1000,0)) + 'k', TEXT(Change_Total_Amount__c)))))))+ ' / ' + TEXT( Changed_Term_years__c ) + 'yrs', ''))
CustomField.label: Amount / Term
